title.zh-TW: 本版未列出已驗證的重點更新
title.en: No verified highlights listed in this release

body.zh-TW: 打開這版的更新紀錄想確認有什麼變動，官方清單裡只看到「Chores」這個日常雜務分類。分類底下直接註明沒有已驗證的更新亮點可供提供，並沒有另外說明具體改動了什麼。
body.en: Opening this release's changelog to see what changed, the official list only shows the "Chores" routine maintenance category. Under that category, it directly notes that no verified release highlights are available, without further explaining what specifically changed.
